resources.string: Press Start to launch StreamBDIX+ inside Termux. First time? Tap Set up Termux.
The last run ended with exit code %1$s. Press Start to run it again.
No live output yet. Press Start Operation: the output shows here once StreamBDIX+ runs inside tmux.
Tap Install / update script to enable the live preview.
Opening Termux. It checks npm for the newest StreamBDIX+ and starts it. A second instance is never started.
Already running (PID: %1$s). Opening your previous Termux session; no new session was started. If Termux shows a different session, swipe in from its left edge, or run: tmux attach -t streambdixplus
Already running (PID: %1$s). Opening your previous Termux session; no new session was started. If Termux shows a different session, swipe in from its left edge and pick the one running StreamBDIX+.
Permission needed: tap Start and follow the steps shown.
StreamBDIX+ is already running. Opening the previous Termux session…
This sends SIGTERM to the running StreamBDIX+ process.
Checking whether Termux accepts commands from this app…
Setup is running in Termux. It can take a few minutes, so keep Termux open until it asks you to press Enter. Afterwards, close and reopen Termux once.

%1$s

The command below was copied to the clipboard. Tap Open Termux, paste it (long-press the screen and choose Paste, or press Ctrl+Shift+V on a keyboard) and press Enter.

When it finishes, fully close and reopen Termux, then come back here and tap Install / update script.
This app does not have the Termux RUN_COMMAND permission yet, so it cannot type into Termux for you.
Termux does not accept commands from this app yet (allow-external-apps is not enabled). The command below turns it on.

StreamBDIX+ Launcher needs the Termux RUN_COMMAND permission. Some TV boxes do not show the system dialog or its Allow button, so pick any way below.

• Show the dialog again.
• Open app settings and switch the permission on (not every TV has this screen).
• No PC needed: copy the command below, paste it into Termux and press Enter. It grants the permission through adb on this device. Turn on USB debugging in Developer options first, and choose Always allow if Android asks. Run it a second time if it said unauthorized.
Note: Android does not know the Termux permission yet. If you installed this launcher before Termux, uninstall and reinstall the launcher, then try again.\n\n
This device has no app-settings screen. Use the command in Termux instead.
Termux is not installed. Install Termux from F-Droid or the official GitHub releases, open it once, then come back.
The permission com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND was not granted.
Termux RunCommandService was not found. Your Termux build is too old or not the official one. Update Termux from F-Droid or GitHub.
Android refused the request to Termux (SecurityException). Make sure the RUN_COMMAND permission is granted. If this launcher was installed before Termux, reinstall the launcher.
Android blocked starting the Termux service from the background. Bring this app to the foreground and try again.
Termux reported an error: %1$s\n\nTap Set up Termux (one-time) to enable allow-external-apps, then restart Termux.
~/start-streambdixplus.sh was not found in Termux. Tap Install / update script.
Node.js is not installed in Termux. Tap Set up Termux (one-time), or in Termux run: pkg install nodejs
npx was not found in Termux. It ships with npm. Tap Set up Termux (one-time), or in Termux run: pkg install nodejs
Termux returned no result. Update Termux to a recent version.
No answer from Termux within 15 seconds. Tap Set up Termux (one-time) to enable allow-external-apps, restart Termux, and make sure Android is not battery-restricting it.

No browser found on this device.
Always installs and runs the newest StreamBDIX+ published on npm (npx streambdixplus@latest), with the newest Node.js from Termux (pkg install nodejs).

Version %1$s

A small launcher for StreamBDIX+ that runs inside Termux. Each Start checks npm for the newest streambdixplus release and runs exactly that version, so there is nothing to update by hand.

The server is local only: %2$s
